title: Sing Pal Thread
style: Indie electronic pop with a pulsing mid-tempo groove, syncopated claps and tight sub-bass; verse stays skeletal with plucked keys and machine-click percussion, pre-chorus opens with filtered stacks and rising noise, chorus lands on wide layered harmonies and a chantable call-and-response. Vocal is close-mic and conversational in verses, doubled and lightly distorted on hooks, with ad-lib echoes and short delay throws. Ear candy includes reverse swells, terminal beeps, and a soft riser into each chorus. Mix is bright, clean, and intimate with a sleek glassy top end., harmony, warm, deep, clean
lyrics:
[Verse 3]
Sing it back, sing it back, the seamstress of the thread,
Taking stress from the stitch where the packets are fed,
SSH into the VDS, Tailscale the mesh,
No Postman at the door, we build the rest.
Sixty domains humming, self-hosted, self-made,
Hermes at the gate, Ollama in the shade,
You drop the crumbs, I pick up the bread,
Construct the mansion where the APIs are led.
No need for the SaaS when the bash is the boss,
Nginx reverse proxy, internal SSL gloss,
Hoppscotch behind the firewall, clean and contained,
Bruno to Git hook, the sync is unchained.
CORS is a ghost when you own the route,
TLS 1.3, no certificate doubt,
The seamstress pulls the thread through the machine,
I’m the needle, you’re the fabric, the code is the seam.

[Verse 4]
OpenRouter at the top, five hundred models deep,
Failover automatic while the orchestra sleeps,
Zuplo on the edge, three hundred nodes awake,
TypeScript at the gateway, no latency to break.
Honcho holds the memory, dialectic and long,
Hermes thinks in threads where the reasoning belongs,
Apify crawls the sixty, the web is the score,
Retained in the vectors, the users ask for more.
Mem0 knows the preference, the session never dies,
Ollama on the VDS, the local GPU cries—
In joy, not in pain, running Mistral and Mixtral,
OpenWebUI the face, the interface crystal.
Apigee governs the traffic, the enterprise spine,
Zapier bridges the gaps where the no-code can shine,
But we make it in-house, super intelligence glam,
Every endpoint a mirror, every agent a program.

[Bridge]
The Nginx template lives in /etc/nginx/sites-available/hoppscotch,
SSL certs self-signed, the internal trust is top-notch,
Proxy pass to 3000, the frontend console glows,
WebSocket at /api/, the realtime engine flows.
Git hook in .git/hooks/post-commit, executable, alive,
bru exports to OpenAPI, the collections arrive,
Curl pushes to Hoppscotch, the database drinks it in,
Bruno and console synchronized, the orchestra wins.
No Postman, no problem, the seamstress said so,
Pick up the crumbs, build the mansion, let the APIs go,
VDS is the foundation, Tailscale the wire,
SSH the key, super intelligence the fire.

[Chorus]
Sing pal, through the SSH night,
Your voice is the only root access I need to sight,
You’re the seamstress, I’m the thread,
In the VDS mansion, where the APIs are fed.
Sixty pages, one stack, in-house, self-made,
The Moderato Plan is the debt already paid—
In code, in rhyme, in the bash and the seam,
Sing it back, sing pal, this is our machine.

[Outro]
The bru CLI is installed.
The hook is chmod +x.
The Nginx config is sites-enabled.
The Ollama model is warm.
The Hermes agent is listening.
Your move, Sing Pal.
What thread do we pull next?
